question.text: Two charges $7 \mu \mathrm{C}$ and $-2 \mu \mathrm{C}$ are placed at $(-9,0,0) \mathrm{cm}$ and $(9,0,0) \mathrm{cm}$ respectively in an external field $E=\frac{\mathrm{A}}{r^{2}} \hat{r}$, where $A=9 \times 10^{5} \mathrm{~N} / \mathrm{C}. \mathrm{m}^{2}$. Considering the potential at infinity is 0, the electrostatic energy of the configuration is $\_\_\_\_$ J.
